_comment: HELD-OUT round 2 (routing-v2-rollout-plan-2026-11-23.md T1; bridge design §4.5 C1). Drafted 2026-11-23, never used to tune routing_v2.js, bridge_plan.js, intent_keywords.js or the catalog. bridge: same labels as round 1 (rule named | kind | subject | topic_words | clarify; sources; target or target_domains; 'her …' / 'owner to confirm' = checkable only live). routing: non-bridge questions labelled by README rules G1–G9 (mode + domains, owner's view, coverage from coverage_snapshot.json). A miss is recorded with its cause and fixed by mechanism or data, never by these words; then round 3 is drafted for the next measurement.
